facts.fact: UNCTAD says the Food and Agricultural Research and Extension Institute (FAREI) has been involved in CropWatch-ICP activities since 2021 and held a CropWatch training workshop on 18-19 September 2025 to build staff capacity in satellite-based crop monitoring and early warning.
